name: brisa
description: Recopilador y gestor de ports nativos de PC al estilo EmuDeck, basado en manifiestos.
author: Kanin

scripts.build: rm -rf dist/core dist/server dist/cli dist/desktop && npx tsx scripts/build-backend.ts && npx tsx scripts/copy-web.ts
scripts.serve: npm run build; concurrently -k -n web,server "npx tsx scripts/copy-web.ts --watch" "nodemon"
scripts.package: npm run build && npx tsx scripts/build-desktop.ts
scripts.package:linux: npm run build && npx tsx scripts/build-desktop.ts --only linux
scripts.package:windows: npm run build && npx tsx scripts/build-desktop.ts --only windows
scripts.test: tsx --test test/glob.test.ts test/version.test.ts test/hash.test.ts test/preserve.test.ts test/tasks.test.ts test/config.test.ts test/cache.test.ts test/manifest.test.ts test/output.test.ts test/status.test.ts
